cards.audioText: Your call sign is SIA786, you are parking at Gate 217, you have got information P, call Wuhan Delivery and request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是新航786，停在217号机位，已收到通播P，呼叫武汉放行，向ATC申请放行至新加坡。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery. SIA786, Gate 217, information P, destination Singapore, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，新航786，217号机位，通播P，目的地新加坡，向ATC申请放行。

cards.audioText: SIA786 Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route. LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10700m. Departure frequency 124.35, squawk 2067.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航786，武汉放行，可以按计划航路放行至新加坡。LKO-01离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10700米。离场频率124.35，应答机2067。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route. LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10700m. Departure frequency 124.35, squawk 2067, SIA786.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路放行至新加坡。LKO-01离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10700米。离场频率124.35，应答机2067，新航786。

cards.audioText: Tell ATC because heavy weight, can't accept 10700m, request 9500m.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉ATC由于机身过重，10700米不可用，请求9500米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA786, negative 10700m due weight, request 9500m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，新航786，由于重量，高度10700米不可用，请求9500米。

cards.audioText: You are on the taxiway A, with engine start completed, contact Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在滑行道A上，发动机已全部启动，联系地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA786 start-up completed, taxiway A, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航786发动机起动完成，在滑行道A上，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: SIA786, Wuhan Ground, taxi to holding point runway 36 via Z4 and A, hold short of E7.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航786，武汉地面，沿滑行道Z4，A滑行至跑道36等待点，在E7外等待。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36 via Z4 and A hold short of E7, SIA786.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道Z4，A滑行至跑道36等待点，E7外等待，新航786。

cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA786, request E7 intersection departure runway 36.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航786，请求从滑行道E7进跑道36起飞。

cards.audioText: Negative due sequencing.[A few minutes later.]SIA786, cleared for takeoff, runway 36, surface wind 350, 5 knots.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 不可以需要排序。【几分钟后。】新航786，可以起飞，跑道36，地面风350，5节。【复诵】

cards.audioText: After 5 hours. You are approaching Singapore airport, your landing gear can't be extended, report this to Singapore Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 5小时后。你正在接近新加坡机场，飞机起落架无法放下，向新加坡进近报告该情况。
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA786, our landing gear can't be extended.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，新航786，我们的起落架无法放下。

cards.audioText: SIA786, say intention?[Tell ATC you want to terminate the approach, maintain 3000ft runway heading, complete the abnormal procedure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航786，请示意图？【告诉管制员你想中止进近，保持3000英尺，保持跑道航向，完成非正常程序。】
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA786, go around, request maintain runway heading and climb to 3000ft to complete abnormal procedure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，新航786，复飞了，请求保持跑道航向，爬升至3000英尺，完成非正常情况程序。

cards.audioText: After finishing the checklist, you find your landing gear still can't be down, inform ATC and request low pass for visual check.
cards.audioTextZh: 完成检查单后，飞机起落架无法放下，向ATC请求低空通场以目视检查。
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA786, our landing gear jammed, request low pass for visual check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，新航786，飞机起落架卡阻，请求低空通场目视检查。

cards.audioText: SIA786, low pass approved.[You are flying low pass the runway, ask Tower whether they saw the gear down normally.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航786，可以低空通场。【飞机在跑道上低空通场，询问塔台，起落架是否可以正常放下。】
cards.referenceText: Singapore Tower, SIA786, confirm gears down normally?
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡塔台，新航786，证实起落架能否正常放下？

cards.audioText: SIA786, your landing gear didn't down.[Tell Tower you decided to land without part of landing gears, ask for foam runway and fire engines. In case of the land without gears, the medical assistance is necessary. ]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航786，起落架没放下。【告诉塔台你打算进行无部分起落架降落，请求提供跑道和消防车。假如无起落架降落，医疗援助是很必要的。】
cards.referenceText: Singapore Tower, SIA786, request fire engines and medical assistance due land part gears up. The foam runway is necessary.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡塔台，新航786，由于实施部分起落架降落，请求提供消防车和医疗援助。需要泡沫跑道。

cards.audioText: SIA786, roger, the association assistance will be ready in second.[You are inbound of approach, call Tower and ask land instruction.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航786，收到，援助组织马上准备好。【你正在向台进近，呼叫塔台，请求着陆指令。】
cards.referenceText: Singapore Tower, SIA786, established the localizer, request land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡塔台，新航786，已建立航道，请求着陆。

cards.audioText: SIA786, cleared to land, wind calm.
